report.summary: Patient Ernesto Villalobos (P-D004), 51, Spanish-speaking, commercial Employer PPO with no transport benefit, home tract 17031610300 (Chicago; low-income, 25% no-vehicle households, 4 transit stops within 800m). Recent screener (2026-10-19) answered no to transportation and utilities shutoff, but both needs were raised at today's visit. Utilities: three options — Shutoff Prevention Clinic (walk-in Tuesdays for disconnection notices), Lakeside Energy Assistance (verified ELIGIBLE via name/DOB/MRN check; help with bills/appointments), Neighborhood Energy Help (income-based gas/electric, apply in person Mon/Wed). Transport: Medicaid Ride Line (Medicaid-only, not eligible — commercial PPO) and Senior Shuttle West (age 60+, not eligible at 51) are excluded. Remaining options: Lakeside Energy Assistance (eligible) and Paratransit Info Desk (ADA certification by phone, decisions up to 21 days). Public transit is locally available (4 stops within 800m, 3 with early service). No future appointment was available to run a specific transit-trip check.
